structure.title: Page structure
structure.help: Click a part of the page on the right, or pick it here.

subtitles.photos: Shown at the top of your restaurant page as a slideshow.
subtitles.details: Shown under the photos and at the bottom of your page.
subtitles.notes: Short messages under your restaurant name.
subtitles.menus: Each menu is a tab on your menu page. Drag to change the order.
subtitles.hours: Used for the Open / Closed status and the weekly schedule.
subtitles.brand: Used for buttons, tabs and highlights on every page.
subtitles.menu: A tab on your menu page.

preview.title: Preview of your public page
preview.hint_select: Select mode: click any part of the page to edit it
preview.hint_browse: Browse mode: the page works like your public site
preview.hint_editing: Editing: {name} · click another part of the page to switch
preview.hint_hidden: Editing: {name} · hidden from guests, so it isn't on the page
preview.hint_brand: Previewing {name} on two pages · nothing is live until you save

brand.primary_help: Buttons, active tabs, tinted backgrounds and the pattern.
brand.content_help: Text and icons on top of the primary tint.
brand.readable_text: Text on tinted backgrounds has {ratio} : 1 contrast (needs 4.5).
brand.hard_to_read_text: Text on tinted backgrounds has {ratio} : 1 contrast, it needs 4.5. Pick a darker text color.

details.name: Restaurant name
details.type_help: Pick from the list; guests see it in their language.
details.phone_help: Same in all languages. Guests can copy it with one tap.

notes.label: Notes
notes.edit_help: Enter to finish · Esc to cancel
notes.info: Keep notes to one short sentence. Hidden notes stay here for later but guests don't see them.

photos.formats: JPG, PNG or WebP · up to 10 MB · landscape works best
photos.uploading: No photos uploading | {count} photo uploading | {count} photos uploading
photos.wrong_type: {name} isn't a JPG, PNG or WebP photo.
photos.info: The first photo is the cover. It's also the image people see when your link is shared in messengers.

hours.time_zone_help: Open / Closed on your page is calculated in this time zone.
hours.after_midnight: Closing after midnight? Enter e.g. 02:00 and it counts toward the same evening.
hours.same_time: Closing time has to differ from the opening time.
hours.overlap: Hours of a day can't overlap.
hours.special_days_help: Holidays and short days override the weekly hours.
hours.end_before_start: The last day can't be before the first one.
hours.close_temporarily_help: For renovation or vacation. Your page shows Closed with your reason until the date you pick.

menus.last_visible_message: Without it, your menu page has no menus until you show one again.
menus.info: {hide} takes a menu off your site for now. {archive} moves it out of this list with all its dishes, ready to restore. {delete} is permanent and only available for archived menus.

menu.name: Menu name
menu.description_help: Optional. Shown under the menu's name.
menu.hidden: Hidden from guests. It stays here, but it isn't on your page.

category.name: Category name
category.description_help: Optional. Shown under the category title.
category.hidden: Hidden from guests with its dishes. It stays here, but it isn't on your page.
category.info: To move a dish to another category, open it and pick Move to category in its ⋯ menu.

dish.shown_help: Turn off to hide it for a while, e.g. when it's sold out.
dish.photo_help: Square works best. Shown at 112 × 112 in the list.
dish.name: Name
dish.badge_help: Optional. Shown as a banner above the dish.
dish.sizes_help: One size shows as text. Two or more become buttons guests can switch, and the price updates.
dish.size_number: The size is a number, e.g. 300.
dish.allergens_help: Guests see these in orange on the list and can hide dishes that contain them.

actions.delete_with: This deletes {contents} too. It can't be undone.
actions.duplicated: “{name}” copied. The copy is hidden till you show it.
